title: Hundreds killed in Iran as US and Israeli strike targets include civilian areas
summary: At least 555 people have been killed in Iran so far by the U.S.-Israeli campaign, the Iranian Red Crescent Society said, and more than 130 cities across the country having come under attack. The US has also announced Kuwait "accidentally" shot down three F-35 fighter jets. FRANCE 24's Reza Sayah tells us more from the ground in Tehran.
